newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes higher on U.S. cash signals.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes higher on U.S. cash signals.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed higher despite a weaker tone to Asian values with the steady demand for U.S. paddy rice cited as the key bullish factor, traders said.
"The market moved to the top of its trading range. We continue to show a separation from Asian values on good demand for paddy rice," a trader said.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 500 contracts, below the 560 traded Tuesday, according to the CBOT.
Rice futures closed 9-1/2 to 11 cents per cwt higher, with January up 11 at $10.62 per cwt.
